scope: Busiest thread across full process including startup, input preparation, cold call, warmup and measured iterations. Percentages are sampled attribution, not isolated warm benchmark timings. Inlining changes attribution. Inclusive rows overlap and must not be added.
commandTemplate: taskset -c 0 env DOTNET_TieredCompilation=0 dotnet-trace collect --profile dotnet-sampled-thread-time,dotnet-common --format Speedscope -o <trace>.nettrace -- dotnet <Release-speed-harness.dll> case <root> <case> <runs>
